***[[February 2024 United States airstrikes in Iraq and Syria]]
****A [[United States Air Force|USAF]] [[General Atomics MQ-9 Reaper|MQ-9 Reaper]] kills three [[Kata'ib Hezbollah]] militants in a precision [[airstrike]] using a [[AGM-114 Hellfire|Hellfire missile]], including a high ranking commander, in [[Baghdad]], [[Iraq]]. *[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**[[2024 Balochistan bombings]]
***Two bombings outside electoral offices in [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]], ahead of tomorrow's [[2024 Pakistani general election|general election]], kill at least 30 people and injure dozens more. The [[Islamic State]] claims responsibility for both attacks. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-bombing-baluchistan-killed-election-471783e425dcfc0e63c235da23c52a73-07/ (AP)]
***Pakistan closes all [[border control|border crossings]] with [[Afghanistan]] until further notice in response to the attacks. [https://pajhwok.com/2024/02/08/pakistan-closes-crossing-points-with-afghanistan/ (Pajhwok)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] launch a wave of [[missile]] and [[drone warfare|drone strikes]] across [[Ukraine]], killing at least five [[civilian]]s and injuring 11 others, including two in [[Kyiv]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-68224416 (BBC News)]
*[[Southern Thailand insurgency]]
**The [[Government of Thailand|Thai government]] and [[Islam in Thailand|Muslim]] [[separatism|separatists]] in [[Thailand|the country]]'s south agree to begin a [[Malaysia]]n-brokered peace process to end an [[insurgency]] which began in 2004. **[[Naranjal, Ecuador|Naranjal]] city councilwoman [[Diana Carnero]] is [[Assassination|shot and killed]] by unknown gunmen immediately following a city council meeting. [https://www.eluniverso.com/guayaquil/comunidad/quien-era-diana-carnero-la-concejal-de-naranjal-asesinada-nota/ (El Universo)]

**A man commits a [[familicide]] in [[Pennsylvania]], United States in which he kills his family of five before shooting at police injuring two officers before committing suicide. The shooter was identified as 43-year-old Canh Le. [https://www.gunviolencearchive.org/incident/2822404 (GVA)]
